caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure, likely female, shown in full length against a plain, light background. The figure wears a long, flowing garment consisting of a red robe with a gold hem and inner lining, and a dark blue or black outer cloak that drapes around the shoulders and hangs down to the feet. The head is covered with a light-colored, cream or white veil that wraps around the neck and drapes over the shoulders. The figure’s face has a pale complexion with light blush on the cheeks and is framed by the veil; the eyes are wide, and the lips are closed. Both hands are visible: the right hand is held up with fingers slightly spread, and the left hand is held across the waist. There appears to be a small, upright rectangular object on the top of the figure’s head. The composition is frontal and symmetrical, with the body and clothing centrally placed and detailed lines and shading to suggest the folds and layers of fabric. The background remains unadorned, providing contrast to the detailed representation of the figure and garments.
title: Virgin Mary
